title: ieee1905: Add Agent AP, Backhaul STA and Assoc STA MLD Configuration TLVs
description:
Add support for "Agent AP MLD Configuration TLV", "Backhaul STA MLD Configuration TLV" and "Associated STA MLD Configuration TLV"

Wi-Fi EasyMesh Specification Version 6.0 chapters 17.2.96, 17.2.97 and 17.2.98
